name: Shelah
title: Descendants of Shem in the Patriarchal Lineage
summary: Shelah (also known as Shelah or Shelach) was the son of Arpachshad and father of Eber in the lineage from Shem to Abraham. He is a vital link in the genealogy of the patriarchs, connecting Noah's descendants with the Hebrew people. He is mentioned in the genealogies of both the Old and New Testaments.

keyEvents.title: Birth as Son of Arpachshad
keyEvents.description: Shelah was born as the son of Arpachshad, who was the son of Shem. He was born when Arpachshad was 35 years old.

keyEvents.title: Father of Eber
keyEvents.description: When Shelah was 30 years old, he had a son named Eber, who became the ancestor of the Hebrews.

keyEvents.title: Lived 403 years after the birth of Eber
keyEvents.description: After Eber was born, Shelah lived for another 403 years and had more sons and daughters.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shelah is listed in the genealogy from Adam to Abraham in 1 Chronicles as part of the chosen lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Shelah is included in Luke's genealogy, tracing Jesus' ancestry back to Adam through the patriarchs, showing his place in salvation history.
